title: Concept: Possible a Google API key in an X-Goog-Api-Key header in source
description: a Google API key in an X-Goog-Api-Key header in a committed file hands the bearer credential to every reader and to every tool that replays the request. Revoking the token is the only step that ends the exposure.
applicability: Source, tests, HTTP fixtures, proxy configuration and browser bundles that may contain a Google API key in an X-Goog-Api-Key header.
risk: API access with the header credential's scopes, from anywhere the value was copied; HIGH severity.
